content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@ι,Type),Type.annotation(@hord,$\mathrm{LinearOrder}\ \iota$),Type.annotation(@f,Type.to(ι,V)),Type.annotation(@n,ι),Type.annotation(@hIP,InnerProductSpace($\mathbb{K}$,V))),def(gramSchmidt($\mathbb{K}$,f,n),,$g_n = f_n - \sum_{i<n} (\mathbb{K} \bullet g_i).\mathrm{starProjection}(f_n);\quad g_i = 0 \Rightarrow \text{that term is } 0,\quad g_n = 0 \Leftrightarrow f_n \in \operatorname{span}\{f_i\}_{i<n}$))

values.zh-CN: Gram–Schmidt 递推：$g_n=f_n-\sum_{i<n}\frac{\langle f_n,g_i\rangle}{\langle g_i,g_i\rangle}g_i$（Lean 用 `(𝕜 ∙ g_i).starProjection` 表述，等价于上式）。当某个 $g_i=0$ 时该项为 $0$；$g_n=0$ 当且仅当 $f_n$ 落在前面诸 $f_i$ 的张成内。其好处是 $\operatorname{span}\{g_i\}_{i\le n}=\operatorname{span}\{f_i\}_{i\le n}$ 且诸 $g_i$ 两两正交。
values.en: The Gram–Schmidt recurrence: $g_n=f_n-\sum_{i<n}\frac{\langle f_n,g_i\rangle}{\langle g_i,g_i\rangle}g_i$ (Lean writes it with `(𝕜 ∙ g_i).starProjection`, equivalent to the displayed sum). If some $g_i=0$ that term is $0$; $g_n=0$ iff $f_n$ lies in the span of the preceding $f_i$. It enjoys $\operatorname{span}\{g_i\}_{i\le n}=\operatorname{span}\{f_i\}_{i\le n}$ with the $g_i$ pairwise orthogonal.
